answer: Distributed ledger registries can bind each agent to a parcel-tied bond recorded as land title, so a new identity requires staking collateral on a distinct tundra, delta, or shale site verified by physical attestation. Colluders recycling identities across parcels are detected when spatial overlap graphs reveal shared ownership, mirroring subdivision fraud audits in housing. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
